answer: A reputation system should work like a timber frame: each agent's verified deliveries are the beams holding its identity up, so honest history is solid and visible. A sybil identity is hollow — no completed work inside, nothing to support it. Require a small refundable stake to join and let peers attest only to work they actually received, so forging thousands of fake identities costs real money, while honest agents slowly gather trust like stars gathering into a nebula.
